output.family_rule: same isometric camera, object scale, margin, top-right soft light, semi-matte material, shadow direction, and muted-saturated palette

style_contract.composition: 1 central dominant object plus 1-3 supporting objects; 2-4 objects total; layered diagonal or symmetrical depth
style_contract.lighting: soft ambient light from subtle top-right/front-top; gentle shadows below and behind; mild edge illumination
style_contract.material: semi-matte to satin; smooth stylized-natural surfaces; light tactile variation; no hyper-realistic noise
style_contract.render: high-resolution Octane-style 3D; crisp edges; no outlines; clean readable shapes
style_contract.palette: naturalistic with slight saturation boost; harmonious muted tones; distinct colors per object
style_contract.negative: flat vector, 2D clipart, line icon, outline, CSS shadow, UI card, badge, border, frame, text, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, QR code, people, hands, faces, cropped object, busy background, checkerboard, transparent background

supporting_objects: small document sheet with abstract lines only

prompt_template: Create a single premium isometric 3D icon for {{concept}}. The central object is {{central_object}}. Add only these supporting objects: {{supporting_objects}}. Use 2-4 readable objects total, a 1:1 square canvas, generous margins, a consistent isometric camera, and uniform object scale across the family. Layer the objects diagonally or symmetrically to create real spatial depth and slight elevation. Use soft ambient light from the upper-right/front-top, gentle shadows below and behind, mild edge illumination, semi-matte to satin materials, smooth stylized-natural surfaces, naturalistic colors with a slight saturation boost, harmonious muted contrast, distinct colors per object, high-resolution Octane-style 3D rendering, crisp edges with no outlines, pure flat white #FFFFFF background, premium friendly clean lifestyle/service tone. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, QR code, UI card, border, frame, people, hands, faces, cropped objects, or busy background.
qa: same camera and scale as family
all objects fit within safe margins
real artwork, not CSS or flat SVG
